نخضار (form XI)
# نَخْضَارُّ (naḵḍārru) /nax.dˤaːr.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
# نَخْضَارَّ (naḵḍārra) /nax.dˤaːr.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
# نَخْضَارِّ (naḵḍārri) /nax.dˤaːr.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
